outcome: sensitivity and specificity of hematological scoring system
cohort: Preterm neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) with clinical and/or laboratory diagnosis of sepsis.
finding: Neonatal sepsis was encountered in 21.5% of admitted preterm neonates, late-onset sepsis (LOS) was more common (58.8%), mortality was 51.6%,  Klebsiella MDR and CoNS were the most commonly encountered organisms, and the isolated families were 100% resistant to ampicillin.
birth_weight: very low or moderately low birth weight (90.9% of neonates)
